# QR encoder

`qrcode.js` is the browser distribution of `qrcode-generator` 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, used under its MIT license. Its copyright and license notice are retained at the top of the file.

Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

Run `npm run vendor:sync` after updating the dependency. QR output is tested by decoding the rendered canvas with the independent `jsqr` decoder.
